findings.title: Humanized config copy is built then discarded; original raw config returned in monitor context
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context (new module, carried over verbatim from the old mark_failed.py), the function copies monitor_environment.monitor.config and converts config["schedule_type"] to its human-readable display value on that copy, but the returned context dict uses "config": monitor_environment.monitor.config — the original, unmodified dict. The modified copy is never used, so the schedule_type humanization is dead code and every monitor-incident occurrence event carries the raw integer schedule_type in its monitor context instead of the display string. The return should use the copied `config`. Behavior is unchanged by this refactor (the bug predates the move), but since this PR creates the new home for this code it is the right time to fix it.
